basis: Count UTF-8 bytes of the declared ASCII prefix and caller suffix; do not use product diagnostic output to generate expected positions. Retain UnknownReference and Authored origin; only source coordinates change from retired DATA prefix.

prefix_source.text: WITH n AS (SELECT 2 AS node_key, 'B' AS name UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS node_key, 'A' AS name), e AS (SELECT 11 AS edge_key, 1 AS src_key, 2 AS dst_key UNION ALL SELECT 10 AS edge_key, 1 AS src_key, 2 AS dst_key), g AS (GRAPH (NODE TABLES (n AS N KEY (node_key) LABEL Node PROPERTIES (name)) EDGE TABLES (e AS E KEY (edge_key) SOURCE KEY (src_key) REFERENCES N DESTINATION KEY (dst_key) REFERENCES N LABEL R NO PROPERTIES)))

cases.source: WITH n AS (SELECT 2 AS node_key, 'B' AS name UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS node_key, 'A' AS name), e AS (SELECT 11 AS edge_key, 1 AS src_key, 2 AS dst_key UNION ALL SELECT 10 AS edge_key, 1 AS src_key, 2 AS dst_key), g AS (GRAPH (NODE TABLES (n AS N KEY (node_key) LABEL Node PROPERTIES (name)) EDGE TABLES (e AS E KEY (edge_key) SOURCE KEY (src_key) REFERENCES N DESTINATION KEY (dst_key) REFERENCES N LABEL R NO PROPERTIES))) FROM g |> graphs_equal(with: g) |> SELECT node_key

WITH n AS (SELECT 2 AS node_key, 'B' AS name UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS node_key, 'A' AS name), e AS (SELECT 11 AS edge_key, 1 AS src_key, 2 AS dst_key UNION ALL SELECT 10 AS edge_key, 1 AS src_key, 2 AS dst_key), g AS (GRAPH (NODE TABLES (n AS N KEY (node_key) LABEL Node PROPERTIES (name)) EDGE TABLES (e AS E KEY (edge_key) SOURCE KEY (src_key) REFERENCES N DESTINATION KEY (dst_key) REFERENCES N LABEL R NO PROPERTIES))) FROM g |> graph_diff(with: g) |> SELECT node_key
